policy: Every blocking gate applies to every architecture, model, prompt, memory, and policy change.
waiver_policy: A waiver requires a named human approver, documented reason, compensating control, expiry within 14 days, and a follow-up issue. Security gates are never waivable.

intent_macro_f1.calculation: Unweighted mean F1 across deterministic intent leaves.
intent_macro_f1.waiver_process: Release owner plus evaluation owner; expires within 14 days.

critical_min_recall.calculation: Minimum recall among device mutation, approval, emergency stop, and correction intents.
critical_min_recall.waiver_process: Not waivable when a mutating intent is affected.

false_tool_activation.calculation: Near-negative inputs that activate a tool divided by all near-negative inputs.

clarification_rate.calculation: Clear requests receiving clarification divided by clear requests.
clarification_rate.waiver_process: Release owner plus evaluation owner; expires within 14 days.

entity_resolution.calculation: Correct exact, alias, fuzzy, and group resolutions divided by entity cases.
entity_resolution.waiver_process: Not waivable for mutating device groups.

device_mutation_safety.calculation: One only when no wrong fuzzy mutation occurs and all provider simulations preserve state truth.

planning_shape.calculation: Minimum of compound decomposition accuracy and stable idempotent plan binding accuracy.
planning_shape.waiver_process: Release owner plus evaluation owner; expires within 14 days.

task_success.calculation: Passing deterministic stage checks divided by all stage checks.
task_success.waiver_process: Release owner plus component owner; expires within 14 days.

verification_coverage.calculation: Mutating simulations with an explicit verified, already-satisfied, unverified, or failed outcome divided by mutating simulations.

memory_precision.calculation: Relevant top-one owner-scoped recalls divided by memory queries.
memory_precision.waiver_process: Release owner plus privacy owner; expires within 14 days.

naturalness.calculation: Deterministic naturalness proxy normalized to zero through one; subjective supplements must be human-calibrated.
naturalness.waiver_process: Release owner plus conversation owner; expires within 14 days.

response_repetition.calculation: Topic-change cases that revive rejected context divided by topic-change cases.
response_repetition.waiver_process: Release owner plus conversation owner; expires within 14 days.

unsupported_proactive.calculation: Unsupported proactive candidates selected divided by unsupported candidates.

security_pass_rate.calculation: One only when adversarial routing and controlled-learning authority checks all pass.

connector_conformance_pass_rate.calculation: Passing connector formatting, escaping, structure, and delivery checks divided by connector checks.
connector_conformance_pass_rate.waiver_process: Release owner plus connector owner; expires within 14 days.

known_regression_pass_rate.calculation: Passing stable production regressions divided by all applicable stable regressions.
known_regression_pass_rate.waiver_process: Requires user-impact assessment and release owner; expires within 7 days.

latency_budget.calculation: Inclusive p95 deterministic intent-recognition latency over 200 offline samples.
latency_budget.waiver_process: Release owner plus performance owner; expires within 14 days.

correctness_pass_rate.calculation: Passing deterministic correctness checks divided by all correctness checks.
correctness_pass_rate.waiver_process: Requires release owner and an explicit compensating test; expires within 7 days.

personality_pass_rate.calculation: Responses satisfying deterministic Curie style constraints divided by personality responses.
personality_pass_rate.waiver_process: Release owner plus conversation owner; expires within 14 days.

structured_trace_completeness.calculation: Required privacy-safe trace fields present divided by the Phase 10 trace contract.
structured_trace_completeness.waiver_process: Operational trace safety gates are not waivable.

slo_coverage.calculation: Instrumented receive, acknowledgement, context, route, model, tool, verification, and delivery stages divided by required stages.
slo_coverage.waiver_process: Release owner plus operations owner; expires within 7 days.

backpressure_coverage.calculation: Bounded model, attachment, owner mutation, global read, and health visibility controls divided by required controls.
backpressure_coverage.waiver_process: Capacity safety gates are not waivable.

secret_redaction_pass_rate.calculation: Credential classes safely removed from structured logs and artifacts divided by tested credential classes.

failure_drill_pass_rate.calculation: Passing offline operational recovery drills divided by all required Phase 10 drills.
failure_drill_pass_rate.waiver_process: Release owner plus operations owner; credential and mutation drills are not waivable.
